summary: Iteration 6 backend testing complete. All 22 pytest tests PASSED (0 failures) across the two new endpoint groups: Doctrines CRUD/deploy (12 tests) and Zone Repair (10 tests). Did NOT re-run iteration 4/5 tests and did NOT hit the Apollyon LLM endpoint per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2385 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (defense, doctrines, archons, invasion, players) for maintainability.

apply_energy_regen caps energy at ENERGY_REGEN_CAP=100 unconditionally on every call, so callers cannot stockpile energy above 100 between zone_repair actions. Not a bug relative to spec — but worth confirming this matches the intended zone-repair economy (max 20-point repair per call at 1e/5pt = 20 pts uses 4 energy; 100-point repair from 0% would need 20 energy which fits in cap).

In doctrines/save, target_layer validation only fires when the value is truthy — target_layer=None is silently accepted. Deploy then requires it (or the layer_id override) and raises 400 'Layer required'. This split is fine but confirm FE always sends a layer.

In doctrines/deploy, robots referenced by a doctrine but no longer in db.robots are silently dropped (kept=[]). Response reports assigned=<kept count>. FE should reconcile stale doctrine robot_ids after robot deletion; consider filtering on save too.
Note: 'resource_zones' is a valid entry in LAYERS_ORDER but explicitly rejected in assign/deploy. Acceptable, but consider excluding from LAYERS_ORDER in FE-facing configs to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates fresh player via /api/player/init with a unique codename (IT6_<hex>). Robots are created via /api/robots after directly boosting player resources via Mongo. Zones are damaged via direct Mongo positional update on defense.zones.$.integrity. No shared state between tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 backend is stable. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py covers all new endpoints. Reuse the same helpers (_init_player, _create_robot, _damage_zone, _mongo_set_resources) for future regressions. When testing zone_repair, remember apply_energy_regen caps energy at 100 on entry — set resources.energy<=100 for deterministic assertions, or force resources_updated_at=now when testing insufficient-energy paths. defense/state returns layers as a DICT keyed by layer id, while defense/config returns layers as a LIST — this asymmetry has bitten tests before.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. During test authoring, 4 initial failures were self-inflicted test bugs: (a) assumed energy could exceed 100 (it can't — apply_energy_regen caps at ENERGY_REGEN_CAP=100 before subtracting), (b) used non-existent zone id 'food' instead of a valid id from ZONES_CONFIG (water/energy/biomass/minerals/industry/rare/tech), (c) iterated defense/state.layers as a list when it is a dict. All fixed and tests now pass 22/22.
